sourceName: Florida Department of Health EMS Data Unit Weekly Providers Report
scope: Florida-issued EMS provider licenses, not a count of unique active organizations. Source-reported headquarters addresses and counties do not establish service area. Out-of-state headquarters remain separate. Expiration is for EMS licensure, never an equipment contract. Contact-person, phone, fax and email fields excluded.
